title: 第十七章 有人刺杀第五更第十八章 被坑了
lines: 家长询问又怎么了？你只是个最低级的老师，不会回答很正常啊！
32　为了装模作样，专门跑过来看第五重功法，不是虚伪、虚荣是什么？
“明天我就去找院长，这种浮躁的家伙必须开除！”
心中冷哼，墨老决定了。
这么虚荣，不好好修炼的家伙，留在学院也只会带坏风气！
张悬不知道就这两次见面，已经让他进入必须开除的名单了，就算知道，也肯定会哭笑不得。
他那些只是借口罢了！
实际上是修为达到这种水平了！
总不能修为达到了，没功法修炼吧！
很快，找到功法的最后一排。
教师之中，最有名、实力最高的也就武者五重，一旦达到第六重辟穴境，就会自动成为学院长老。
这里只是教师藏书阁，并没有第六重功法的记载，因此，第五重的功法，被放在了最后一排。
“第五重的书籍，明显比第四重要少了一圈！”
同样是功法秘籍，第四重密密麻麻足有两、三千本，而第五重，最多只有一千来本，少了接近二分之一。
其实想想也很正常，任何事情几乎都是递增关系，越到高处，也就越稀少，学院传承的年数虽然不短，但能达到武者五重的，肯定比达到第四重的要少的多。
留下的功法、笔记，自然也就少了。
摇摇头，不去想这些事情，张悬随手抽出一本，开始翻阅。
大半个时辰后。
最后一排书架上的上千本功法秘籍，已经全部翻完，天道图书馆也各自形成了对应的书籍。
得到了想要的，张悬微微一笑，和墨老告辞，向住处走去。
见他又是乱翻、乱看，甚至连停都不停，墨老难免心中再次骂了一顿。
重新回到住处。
张悬故技重施，意念中寻找上千本书籍中所有正确的语句、段落了。
果然，时间不长，图书馆再次生成了一本书本，这次不再是没有名字，而是直接写上了《天道神功》四个大字。
继续修炼。
武者五重鼎力境，其实是皮骨境的延续，目的很简单，是让修炼者把真气锤炼的更加纯熟，鼎力境每个级别力量不同，实际上就是真气和肌肉的配合程度。
配合的越好，力量发挥越大。
看到天道神功上面关于鼎力境的描述，张悬屏住精神，仔细控制丹田内清澈如水的真气，缓慢在体内游走，让其完美融入身体的节奏。
天道神功，不愧是搜集上千本秘籍融合而成的功法，修炼起来速度极快，按照上面的方法，真气和肌肉运转，迅速融合。
身体力量和真气的配合度也笔直上升。
鼎力境初期！
鼎力境中期！
鼎力境后期！
鼎力境巅峰！
轰隆隆！
两个时辰后，身体再次一震。
张悬再次睁开眼睛，满是不可思议：“这……武者五重巅峰了？”
本以为武者第五重需要很长时间的修炼，做梦都没想到，使用天道神功的方法，同样两个时辰就达到巅峰。
修炼对前身来说，难如登天，可对于修炼了天道神功的张悬来说，简直和吃饭喝水一样简单。
只花费了半夜的功夫，就从武者三重真气境，修炼到了第五重巅峰……这也太夸张了吧！
而且，如果不是不知道第六重的修炼方法，不知道应该开辟哪个穴道，恐怕现在都已经突破成功，变成武者六重辟穴境强者了！
武者六重辟穴境，开辟全身穴道，每开辟一处，真气就浑厚一分，实力也增强一分。
传说，人体一共108处穴道，能够开启的，不过72枚，而且这些穴道如何开辟是有顺序的，每个人体质不同，需要不同顺序才能达到最佳效果，找不到方法，终其一生，恐怕也只能开辟三、四十个穴道，就再无法进步。
这就好像清理河道淤泥，从上游向下慢慢清理，能彻底清理干净，而中间向两头清理，非但弄不干净，弄不好还会让河流堵塞，再无法继续！
content_en:
What's wrong with parents asking? You are just the lowest level teacher, it is normal that you cannot answer!
32. In order to show off, I came here specifically to see the fifth level of exercises. What is it if it’s not hypocrisy or vanity?
"I will go to the dean tomorrow. This impetuous guy must be fired!"
With a cold snort in his heart, Mr. Mo decided.
Such a vain guy who doesn't practice well will only bring bad vibes if he stays in the academy!
Zhang Xuan didn't know that just these two meetings had already put him on the list of people who had to be expelled. Even if he knew, he would definitely not know whether to laugh or cry.
Those are just excuses!
In fact, his cultivation has reached this level!
You can't reach the level of cultivation. You don't have the skills to practice!
Soon, I found the last row of exercises.
Among the teachers, the most famous and powerful ones are the fifth-level warriors. Once they reach the sixth-level acupoint opening realm, they will automatically become the elders of the academy.
This is just the teacher's library, and there is no record of the sixth level of exercises. Therefore, the fifth level of exercises are placed in the last row.
"The fifth-level books are obviously one less important than the fourth-level books!"
There are also two or three thousand secret books of secret techniques in the fourth level, while in the fifth level, there are only about a thousand copies at most, which is nearly one-half less.
In fact, it's normal if you think about it. Everything is almost in an incremental relationship. The higher you go, the rarer it becomes. Although the number of years of inheritance in the academy is not short, those who can reach the fifth level of warriors are definitely much less than those who have reached the fourth level.
Naturally, there are fewer exercises and notes left behind.
Shaking his head and not thinking about these things, Zhang Xuan took out a book and started reading.
More than half an hour later.
The thousands of secret techniques and secret books on the last row of bookshelves have all been read, and the Tiandao Library has also formed corresponding books.
After getting what he wanted, Zhang Xuan smiled slightly, said goodbye to Mr. Mo, and walked towards his residence.
Seeing him flipping and looking randomly again, and even not stopping, Mr. Mo couldn't help but cursed again in his heart.
Return to your residence.
Zhang Xuan repeated his old trick, mentally searching for all the correct sentences and paragraphs in thousands of books.
Sure enough, not long after, the library once again generated a book. This time it no longer had no name, but directly had the four characters "Tiandao Shen Gong" written on it.
Continue to practice.
The fifth level of the Dali realm for warriors is actually the continuation of the Skin and Bone realm. The purpose is very simple, which is to allow practitioners to temper their true energy more proficiently. The strength of each level of the Dali realm is different, which is actually the degree of cooperation between the true energy and muscles.
The better the coordination, the greater the power.
Seeing the description of the powerful realm in the Tiandao Divine Art, Zhang Xuan held his nerves and carefully controlled the clear water-like Qi in his Dantian, slowly swimming through his body so that it could perfectly blend into the body's rhythm.
The Divine Art of Heaven is indeed a method that was collected from thousands of secret books. It can be practiced very quickly. According to the above method, the true energy and muscles circulate and merge quickly.
The coordination between body strength and infuriating energy also skyrocketed.
Early stage of Dali Realm!
The middle stage of Dali Realm!
Late stage of Dali Realm!
The peak of Dali Realm!
Boom!
Two hours later, his body was shaken again.
Zhang Xuan opened his eyes again, full of disbelief: "Is this...the fifth level warrior at the peak?"
I thought that the fifth level of martial arts would take a long time to practice, but I never imagined that using the method of Heavenly Dao Divine Art, I could reach the peak in the same two hours.
For his predecessor, cultivation was as difficult as climbing to the sky, but for Zhang Xuan, who had practiced the divine art of heaven, it was as simple as eating and drinking.
It only took half a night of effort to go from the third level of martial artist's true energy realm to the fifth level of peak... This is too exaggerated!
Moreover, if it were not for not knowing the cultivation method of the sixth level and which acupuncture points should be opened, I am afraid that he would have succeeded in breaking through and become a strong warrior at the sixth level of acupoint opening!
The warrior has reached the sixth level of acupoint opening, opening up acupuncture points all over the body. Every time a point is opened, the true energy becomes thicker and the strength becomes stronger.
Legend has it that there are a total of 108 acupoints in the human body, of which only 72 can be opened. Moreover, there is an order in how to open these acupoints. Everyone's body is different and requires a different order to achieve the best results. If you can't find a method, you will probably only be able to open 30 or 40 acupoints in your lifetime, and you will no longer be able to make progress.
This is like cleaning up the silt in a river. If you clean it slowly from the upstream to the bottom, it can be completely cleaned. If you clean it from the middle to both ends, not only will it not be cleaned, but it will also block the river and make it impossible to continue!
